registry-smoke.title: Portable registry and parity smoke
preflight: Use a clean or explicitly fingerprinted source revision.
Do not interpret portable skips as backend timing evidence.
registry-smoke.promotion_boundary: This command can prove registry/parity contracts only; it cannot promote a physical timing row.

python-load-matrix.title: Python CUDA, MPS, or CPU exact HDF5 load
preflight: Record branch, full HEAD, dirty diff hash, host, device owner, runtime, and source identity before launch.
Coordinate exclusive accelerator ownership and declare source-page/cache state.
Run one smoke before a matrix and preserve every repetition and outlier.
Confirm the expected full-volume hash, storage shape/dtype, scan shape, source/working detector shapes, source dtype, and detector bin are bound to the same fixture.
required_artifacts: run-level JSON with p50, p95, and maximum
logical resident, sampled accelerator/process lower-bound peaks, lifetime process RSS, and swap telemetry
external process-tree, compressed-memory, and pageout telemetry when required by the physical gate
python-load-matrix.promotion_boundary: A warm package result cannot satisfy a cold-source or application gate.

swift-indexed-load.title: Native Swift/Metal exact indexed load
swift-indexed-load.owner: MacBook Pro (M5 Max, 128 GB), MacBook Air (M2, 8 GB), or MacBook Pro (M5, 24 GB)
preflight: Use an empty output directory and a source-identity-bound value-range audit.
Verify the detector bin is supported by Metal4DSTEMLoadPlan; bin 8 must fail closed in the current Swift contract.
Coordinate physical-device ownership and record maxBufferLength and recommended working-set size.
required_artifacts: benchmark JSON and complete working-volume hashes
Metal allocation, process RSS/footprint, pressure, and swap telemetry
swift-indexed-load.promotion_boundary: The package benchmark excludes Live4DSTEM policy, UI, cache lifecycle, and headed wall-to-wall acceptance.

webgpu-load.title: Hardware-WebGPU local HDF5 load
webgpu-load.owner: MacBook Pro (M5 Max, 128 GB), MacBook Pro (M5, 24 GB), or MacBook Air (M2, 8 GB)
preflight: Confirm the browser adapter is hardware Metal WebGPU, software=false.
Record the exact exported HTML/source revision and browser version.
Verify source dtype, exact uint16 resident width, source/working geometry, exact integer range, and device limits before timing.
Require a complete output SHA-256 in addition to diagnostic frame checksums; three frame probes never qualify a full-volume gate.
Fail before timing detector bins 2, 4, or 8 until production integer accumulation and residency replace the current float32 path.
required_artifacts: browser profile JSON with run-level timings
independent full-output SHA-256 plus diagnostic frame checksums
browser-tree RSS, adapter allocation when available, and swap telemetry
webgpu-load.promotion_boundary: Software adapters, float32 resident substitutions, and uncontrolled single runs cannot satisfy exact integer or minimum-memory gates.

screening-profile.title: Exact screening products and prepared-result lifecycle
screening-profile.owner: Linux CUDA workstation (dual 96 GB Blackwell GPUs) or MacBook Pro (M5 Max, 128 GB)
preflight: Check accelerator ownership and retain the concurrent-service baseline.
Use a frozen mask/calibration or record bootstrap validation and any second-pass fallback.
Keep source build, first usable, exact complete, and prepared-result reopen separate.
required_artifacts: run-level timing and cache lifecycle JSON
mean DP, total, BF, DF, CoM, rotation, and iDPC parity
GPU allocation/reserve/total-card and host RSS/swap telemetry
screening-profile.promotion_boundary: Prepared-result reopen is reported separately from source screening construction.

python-selective-load.title: CUDA or MPS evidence-selective load
python-selective-load.owner: Linux CUDA workstation (dual 96 GB Blackwell GPUs) or MacBook Pro (M5 Max, 128 GB)
preflight: Freeze selector order, duplicates, coordinate convention, source identity, and detector selection.
Record bytes read, decompressed, copied, and uploaded; load-then-slice is a failure.
Run rectangle, sparse/random, and duplicate/order smoke cases before scale tests.
required_artifacts: exact ordered output and metadata parity
python-selective-load.promotion_boundary: Only evidence-selective reads qualify; full-scan decode followed by slicing is rejected.

webgpu-selective-load.title: Hardware-WebGPU rectangle-selective load
webgpu-selective-load.owner: MacBook Pro (M5 Max, 128 GB) or MacBook Air (M2, 8 GB)
preflight: Confirm a physical hardware adapter and fresh browser target per repetition.
Freeze the rectangle in row-start,row-stop,column-start,column-stop order.
Retain shard/range bytes and reject a no-frame-span all-shard fallback.
required_artifacts: full selected-tensor parity or explicitly qualified probe coverage
webgpu-selective-load.promotion_boundary: Prepared shard selection does not prove intra-shard byte-range selection or arbitrary ordered positions.

detector-product-parity.title: Detector-product exactness preflight
detector-product-parity.owner: Portable CI runner plus specified backend computer
detector-product-parity.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_integer_detector_products.py tests/test_products_parity.py tests/test_cuda_virtual_image.py
preflight: Do not change masks, scan coverage, detector bin, dtype, or accumulation range.
Backend skips remain open hardware gates.
required_artifacts: backend-specific physical timing from a separate runbook
detector-product-parity.promotion_boundary: Parity-only execution does not satisfy a speed or memory gate.

dpc-parity.title: CoM, DPC, rotation, and iDPC parity preflight
dpc-parity.owner: Portable CI runner plus specified backend computer
dpc-parity.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_dpc_rotation_agreement.py tests/test_products_parity.py tests/test_display_fft_parity.py
preflight: Preserve explicit row/column order and frozen Fourier conventions.
Record full-precision max, p99, normalized error, and signal range on hardware.
required_artifacts: physical backend synchronized timing and parity artifact
dpc-parity.promotion_boundary: Portable agreement cannot replace a physical backend run.

display-fft-parity.title: Display transform, histogram, color, and FFT parity
display-fft-parity.owner: Portable CI runner plus specified backend computer
display-fft-parity.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_display_parity.py tests/test_display_fft_parity.py tests/test_display_shared_goldens.py
preflight: Keep source dtype, transform, normalization, color limits, and FFT convention fixed.
Measure physical first execution and warm publication separately.
required_artifacts: physical first-execution and warm timing artifact
display-fft-parity.promotion_boundary: Golden parity is necessary but not a frame-pacing result.

mps-ssb.title: Python MPS SSB reconstruction and calibration
preflight: Use native acquisition evidence; do not promote a Fourier-resized microscope.
Freeze detector sampling, seed, objective, bounds, and reference engine.
Separate preparation, pair/object/phase/loss, 200 trials, and Nelder-Mead.
mps-ssb.promotion_boundary: A fixed-pair kernel timing cannot replace the complete 200-trial plus Nelder-Mead workflow.

swift-ssb.title: Native Swift/Metal SSB reconstruction and calibration
swift-ssb.owner: MacBook Pro (M5 Max, 128 GB) or MacBook Pro (M5, 24 GB)
preflight: Verify metadata, BF plane order, phase reference, and package revision hashes.
Keep complete and finite cache policies as separate rows.
Retain every fit repetition and output fingerprint.
swift-ssb.promotion_boundary: Package timing excludes application interaction and presentation.

cuda-ssb-preflight.title: CUDA SSB parity preflight
cuda-ssb-preflight.owner: Linux CUDA workstation (dual 96 GB Blackwell GPUs)
cuda-ssb-preflight.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_ssb_cuda_128.py tests/test_ssb_backend_contract.py tests/test_ssb_persistence.py
preflight: Confirm the intended GPU is unoccupied before any later physical profile.
Use the frozen full-precision reference and deterministic seed.
cuda-ssb-preflight.promotion_boundary: The current repository entry point is parity-only; a stable CUDA SSB performance harness remains an explicit gate.

webgpu-ssb-preflight.title: WebGPU SSB hardware parity preflight
webgpu-ssb-preflight.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_ssb_backend_contract.py tests/test_webgpu_sources.py tests/test_webgpu_widget_sync.py
preflight: Treat software WebGPU as smoke only.
Do not promote a phase result that misses the frozen wrapped-error tolerance.
required_artifacts: physical browser phase/loss parity and timing artifact
webgpu-ssb-preflight.promotion_boundary: The retained physical WebGPU SSB phase mismatch stays refuted until exact parity is restored.
